/intro/#0/text: I'm back! Phew, I made it!
/intro/#3/text: Back safe and sound! Applause, please!
/intro/#4/text: Boss, Boss! You gotta hear this!
/intro/#11/text: Heh heh, back in one piece.
/intro/#13/text: I'm back! Missed me, didn't you?
/intro/#17/text: I'm home. The wind was kind today.
/intro/#18/text: Home safe. Shall I tell you about it?
/rare/#0/text: Look! It's all sparkly! I did good today, right?
/rare/#1/text: No way! A rare one! My hands are shaking!
/rare/#2/text: Don't faint, okay… Ta-da! A rare find!
/rare/#3/text: Jackpot! This {item}… I've never seen anything like it!
/rare/#4/text: My pocket's glowing! This is the real deal!
/rare/#5/text: Today's loot champ: me! Shiny get!
/rare/#6/text: Treasure just lying on the road! Snatched it!
/rare/#7/text: If we sell this, we're rich, right? Right?!
/rare/#8/text: Found a shiny! My heart's going ba-dum ba-dum!
/rare/#9/text: Lucky day, Boss! This is the good stuff, right?
/rare/#10/text: This one's rare. Use it well.
/rare/#12/text: Brought a rare one. Skip the praise.
/rare/#14/text: Shiny thing. Can't eat it, apparently.
/rare/#15/text: Heh heh, now this is a fine find.
/rare/#16/text: Heh, a real catch for once. Don't waste it, lad.
/rare/#17/text: Heh, this {item}, of all things. Lady Luck smiled.
/rare/#18/text: These old eyes haven't rusted. See?
/rare/#19/text: Snagged a shiny. Don't tell the youngsters.
/rare/#20/text: Ta-da~ Jackpot! Sera's the best, right?
/rare/#21/text: Lookie~ Sparkly! Admit it, I've got taste.
/rare/#23/text: Finding this {item} takes skill! Praise me!
/rare/#24/text: Treasure spotted! Nothing gets past Sera~
/rare/#25/text: Hmph. This {item}. Even the metal smells better.
/rare/#26/text: This {item}… you see work like this maybe twice in a life.
/rare/#27/text: Heh. Sharp eye, eh? Can't fool a miner.
/rare/#28/text: This {item}'s too good to melt down. Use it.
/rare/#29/text: Drinks are on me tonight. Struck it rare.
/rare/#30/text: I found something rare. Like a fallen star.
/rare/#31/text: The forest gave me a gift today.
/rare/#32/text: Look at this glow. I can almost hear an old song.
/rare/#33/text: The wind led me to it. Here.
/rare/#34/text: Shiny things always wait so quietly, don't they?
/regions/back_hill/tough/#0/text: A boar chased me up a tree for half a day… I swear!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#1/text: The {monster} whacked my butt… I can't even sit!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#2/text: A Big Squirrel pelted me with acorns! Ow, I've got a bump!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#3/text: Was Back Hill always this scary? My legs are jelly…
/regions/back_hill/tough/#4/text: Dodged the {monster}, fell in the creek! Totally soaked!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#5/text: Got lost and passed the same tree three times… sob
/regions/back_hill/tough/#6/text: Poked a beehive. See how puffy my face is?
/regions/back_hill/tough/#8/text: I took on a boar head-to-head! …The boar won, though!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#9/text: Like a hundred bee stings! No, a thousand!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#10/text: Tumbled down the hill! But I didn't drop the loot!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#12/text: Got stung a few times. No big deal.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#13/text: Went the long way around the {monster}. Legs hurt. Stomach too.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#14/text: Poked a beehive. Face is a bit puffy.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#15/text: Dodged a boar, fell in the creek. Still drying.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#16/text: Was this hill always so steep? My knees noticed first.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#17/text: The {monster} got a hit in. That's age for you, lad.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#18/text: Heh, thought it'd be a stroll. Turned into a hike.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#19/text: Slippery path. Nearly fell. Keep that between us.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#20/text: That {monster} was hopping around like a youngster.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#21/text: Why's Back Hill so rough? My hair's a total mess!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#22/text: The {monster} chased me! Sera's legs are jelly~
/regions/back_hill/tough/#23/text: Mud splash! These boots were brand new!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#24/text: I almost got lost. You'll keep it a secret, right?
/regions/back_hill/tough/#25/text: Ugh, I hate the {monster}! Still got the goods, though.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#26/text: Hills aren't fair to short legs. Hmph.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#27/text: The {monster} kept going for my ankles. Coward.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#28/text: Hate hills. Give me a good tunnel.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#29/text: Out of breath. One ale'll fix it.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#30/text: A lamp's no use in a meadow. Tch.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#31/text: The hill wind was fierce today. My hair's all tangled.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#32/text: The {monster} was more stubborn than I thought. I'm a little tired.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#33/text: The grass hid the path. I wandered for quite a while.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#34/text: The dew soaked my bowstring. My arrows kept going astray.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#35/text: The hill kept its heart closed today.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#0/text: Ran into the {monster}, but I tiptoed right past!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#1/text: Got a splinter chopping wood. But look how much I got!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#2/text: Did a lap of Back Hill! Worked up a sweat~
/regions/back_hill/normal/#3/text: Almost tossed some Iron Ore, thought it was a pebble. Hehe!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#4/text: Had a staring contest with the {monster}. I won!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#5/text: Stopped to eat wild berries, so I'm a bit late. Shh!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#6/text: Hauling logs back wrecked my shoulders~
/regions/back_hill/normal/#7/text: Perfect weather on the hill! Got some fresh air!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#8/text: I conquered Back Hill! Should've planted a flag!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#9/text: Raced the {monster}! It was a tie!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#14/text: Chopped some wood. Got a splinter.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#15/text: Squirrel threw acorns at me. Ignored it.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#17/text: Chased off the {monster}. Nice warm-up, lad.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#18/text: Gathered wood. Firewood never goes to waste.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#19/text: Heh, the birds were singing, so I joined in. Don't ask about my pitch.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#20/text: Easy lap. Let's have some tea, lad.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#21/text: Back Hill: conquered! Sera's cool, right?
/regions/back_hill/normal/#22/text: The {monster}? I gave it a little scare~
/regions/back_hill/normal/#23/text: Hair blowing in the wind the whole way~ Total photo shoot!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#24/text: The trees smelled so nice~ Best mood ever!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#25/text: Broke a little sweat. A cute one!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#26/text: Did Back Hill. Picked up some rocks.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#28/text: Hmph. Trees everywhere. Not a scrap of ore.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#29/text: Just a stroll. Got grass in my beard.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#30/text: Nothing happened. Pour me a drink.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#31/text: The flowers on the hill said hello.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#33/text: The wind carried the scent of trees. A lovely day.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#34/text: A plain path, but the sky was clear.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#35/text: I found a little hidden trail.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#0/text: Back Hill's just a stroll now! Hummed all the way~
/regions/back_hill/easy/#1/text: The {monster}? It ran from me! Haha!
/regions/back_hill/easy/#2/text: Ate my lunch and even took a nap. Shh!
/regions/back_hill/easy/#3/text: Too easy, Boss! Send me somewhere tougher! …Not too tough, though.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#4/text: The {monster} even showed me the way! Haha!
/regions/back_hill/easy/#5/text: I could do it blindfolded. Back Hill master!
/regions/back_hill/easy/#6/text: The loot just rolled right to me~ Lucky, huh?
/regions/back_hill/easy/#7/text: Sang with the birds the whole way. La-la~
/regions/back_hill/easy/#8/text: Beat Back Hill with one hand! Haha!
/regions/back_hill/easy/#9/text: The {monster} bowed down to me! For real!
/regions/back_hill/easy/#10/text: I was so fast the wind couldn't keep up!
/regions/back_hill/easy/#12/text: The {monster}? Didn't see it. Oh wait, maybe I did.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#13/text: Too close. Send me farther next time.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#14/text: Back Hill's a stroll. Napped, too.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#15/text: Got the stuff fast. Nothing else to do.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#16/text: Back Hill? Did it with my eyes shut. Really shut.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#17/text: The {monster} stepped aside for me. Polite fellow.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#18/text: Heh, that's no adventure, lad. That's a stroll. My knees loved it.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#19/text: Heh, an acorn fell. Caught it. Ate it.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#21/text: Back Hill? One wink and done~
/regions/back_hill/easy/#22/text: The {monster} must have a crush on me. Followed me everywhere!
/regions/back_hill/easy/#23/text: Picked flowers on my walk. Want one?
/regions/back_hill/easy/#24/text: So easy I took a nap. Shh!
/regions/back_hill/easy/#25/text: For Sera, that's just a walk around the block~
/regions/back_hill/easy/#27/text: The {monster} saw me and bolted. Heh.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#31/text: I followed a butterfly, and suddenly I was home.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#32/text: The {monster} bowed its head to me.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#33/text: I made a crown of wildflowers. Would you like it?
/regions/back_hill/easy/#34/text: The wind showed me the way.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#35/text: My steps felt light as a feather.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#0/text: Bats got tangled in my hair! Never again… wait, I have to go back?
/regions/old_mine/tough/#1/text: A Baby Rock Golem came rolling at me! Almost got flattened!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#2/text: Pitch dark AND the {monster}! My torch died, so I crawled out…
/regions/old_mine/tough/#3/text: Slipped on a Mine Slime. I'm sticky all over!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#4/text: Rocks came pouring from the ceiling! Nearly cracked my skull!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#5/text: The {monster} chased me into a dead end… Waaah!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#6/text: Heard the tunnel creaking. My heart hit the floor!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#7/text: I heard a mine ghost… I'm serious!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#8/text: Felt like I was stuck in there for a hundred years!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#9/text: The {monster} was as big as a house! No, a mountain!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#10/text: I ate a whole bucket of coal dust! Tastes awful, seriously!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#12/text: The {monster} was a pain. Gonna lie down.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#13/text: Ceiling almost came down. Eh. I'm alive.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#15/text: Baby golem rolled at me. Dodging wore me out.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#16/text: The mine ran deeper than I figured. Torch barely held out.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#17/text: The {monster} scratched my armor. More polishing for me.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#18/text: Low ceiling. Bonked my head three times.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#19/text: Bats got stuck in my beard. Need a comb, lad.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#20/text: Heh heh, swallowed a bowlful of dust. Can't stop coughing.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#21/text: The Old Mine's way too dark! There's a bat in my hair!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#22/text: The {monster} got my clothes all sticky… ewww.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#23/text: Mines are so not my style. Seriously!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#24/text: Rocks fell from the ceiling! Sera almost got squished!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#25/text: The {monster} was scary, okay? Comfort me~
/regions/old_mine/tough/#26/text: Hmph. These supports are rotten. Watch your step.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#27/text: The {monster} pack was blocking the ore vein.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#28/text: Air gets heavy down deep. My lamp kept flickering.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#29/text: Old pick marks. Places get abandoned for a reason.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#30/text: Tough run. Ore smelled good, though.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#31/text: It's so stifling underground… I missed the sky.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#32/text: The {monster} leapt out of the dark! My heart nearly stopped.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#33/text: The tunnels were too cramped to draw my bow. Quite a struggle.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#34/text: My hair is full of dust.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#35/text: The darkness was long. The light is so welcome.
/regions/old_mine/normal/#0/text: Taught the {monster} a lesson or three!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#1/text: So hot in the mine! I was sweating buckets!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#2/text: A hundred pickaxe swings! My arms are falling off~
/regions/old_mine/normal/#3/text: The echoes were creepy, but I acted totally brave!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#4/text: Rode a mine cart all the way down! So fun!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#5/text: The {monster} kept bugging me, so — bonk! Hehe, no problem!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#6/text: Made it on one torch. My eyes are all blurry~
/regions/old_mine/normal/#7/text: Mining coal turned my nose black. Don't laugh!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#8/text: I swung my pickaxe so hard sparks flew!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#9/text: I knocked out like ten of the {monster}! Ballpark!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#10/text: I went all the way to the end of the mine! Probably!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#18/text: Swinging a pick is hard work, young or old.
/regions/old_mine/normal/#19/text: Heh, now I know why miners sing. Sheer boredom.
/regions/old_mine/normal/#20/text: Swallowed some coal dust. Good for the digestion, I'm sure.
/regions/old_mine/normal/#21/text: Mine explored~ Even the bats fell for Sera!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#22/text: Poke, poke! A few arrows for the {monster}!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#23/text: Coal dust everywhere. I need to redo my makeup~
/regions/old_mine/normal/#24/text: Zoomed down in a mine cart~ Wheee!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#25/text: Saw sparkly Silver in there. Sooo pretty!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#27/text: The {monster}? To a miner, they're just neighbors.
/regions/old_mine/normal/#28/text: Hmph. Ore like this is a snap.
/regions/old_mine/normal/#29/text: Tunnels are home. I don't get lost.
/regions/old_mine/normal/#30/text: Nice grain on this Iron Ore. Use it well.
/regions/old_mine/normal/#31/text: The mine was so still. Perhaps stones dream too.
/regions/old_mine/normal/#32/text: One arrow was enough for the {monster}.
/regions/old_mine/normal/#34/text: Even in the dark, the bats showed me the way.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#0/text: Mine Slime? One hit! Lugging all the loot was the hard part!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#1/text: The {monster} stepped aside for me! Am I famous now?
/regions/old_mine/easy/#2/text: I memorized the whole mine! I could go blindfolded!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#3/text: Made friends with the bats. Just kidding, haha!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#5/text: Iron Ore piled up on the floor! I just scooped it up~
/regions/old_mine/easy/#6/text: The Old Mine's a walk in the park! Send me again!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#7/text: My bag's about to burst. Did I dig too much?
/regions/old_mine/easy/#8/text: Behold the King of the Old Mine! Ahem!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#9/text: The {monster} trembled when it heard my name!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#10/text: So much loot, hauling it home nearly killed me!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#14/text: Slimes go down in one hit. Just annoying.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#15/text: Know every tunnel. Could go eyes closed.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#16/text: Heh heh, the Old Mine? My knees didn't even creak.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#17/text: The {monster}? Fled at the sight of my armor.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#18/text: I know every path. No map needed, lad.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#19/text: Heh, just watched the slimes slip and slide.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#21/text: Old Mine? Strutted through it like a runway~
/regions/old_mine/easy/#22/text: The {monster} stepped aside for me! Well, I AM Sera!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#23/text: I can see fine without a torch. Great eyes!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#24/text: Went all the way to the end and back~ Tee-hee!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#25/text: So easy it was boring. Praise me anyway!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#26/text: Heh. This is my front yard.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#28/text: Ore rolled right up to me.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#31/text: Even the darkness was kind today.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#33/text: A light trip. The ore was heavy, though.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#34/text: Little flowers were blooming even in the mine.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#35/text: A quiet road. Even the stones were sleeping.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#0/text: Three Goblin Scouts! I tiptoed away. Please keep that secret…
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#1/text: Got stuck in a giant web and barely wriggled out! Eek!
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#2/text: Breathed in some spores and now the world's spinning…
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#3/text: The {monster} caught me! I almost died, seriously!
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#4/text: Fell into a goblin trap! Ripped my pants…
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#5/text: Hid from the {monster} in a bush. Didn't dare breathe!
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#6/text: Goblin drums all night… I didn't sleep a wink!
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#7/text: Got lost in the woods and went in circles till sunset!
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#8/text: A hundred goblins chased me! Or was it fifty?
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#10/text: Got lost and nearly bawled… I didn't cry, though!
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#11/text: Lots of goblins. Two of us next time.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#13/text: Muddy woods. Rough. Need a bath.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#14/text: Got caught in a web. Still sticky.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#16/text: Goblins came at me in a mob. My back will never forgive me.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#17/text: Hid from the {monster} for a while. Tactical retreat, lad.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#19/text: Breathed in some spores. The world spun a bit.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#20/text: Heh, got my beard caught in a web. Don't you laugh.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#21/text: Soooo many goblins! Sera was sweating bullets~
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#23/text: Toadstool stink, the worst! My head's still spinning~
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#24/text: Got stuck in a web. Sticky, yuck!
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#25/text: Shaking off the {monster} wore my legs out~
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#26/text: Forest's noisy. The {monster} yapping all over.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#27/text: Kept tripping on roots. Beard got snagged too.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#29/text: Can't tell north in a forest. Give me underground.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#31/text: The forest was angry. The {monster} was everywhere.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#32/text: I slipped past three goblin traps. So very close.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#33/text: The trees blocked my path… The forest was testing me, I think.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#34/text: The forest didn't welcome me today. Thorns scratched me all over.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#35/text: I almost ran out of arrows.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#0/text: Had a showdown with the {monster}! It was close~
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#1/text: The woods were so deep! I found my way back by the moss!
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#2/text: Steered clear of goblin tracks. Smart, huh?
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#3/text: Cut my hand skinning hides. Kiss it better?
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#4/text: Snuck past the {monster}! Held my breath forever~
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#5/text: Manastone glinting in the bushes! Eagle eyes, that's me!
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#6/text: Dodging webs made me a limbo champ. Hehe!
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#7/text: The woods smell great. I didn't eat any mushrooms, honest!
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#8/text: Won a staring contest with a goblin! It was scary!
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#9/text: Lost the {monster} like a pro! Applause!
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#10/text: Went deep, deep into the woods! Brave, huh?
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#15/text: Deep woods. Followed the moss back.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#18/text: Noisy goblin drums. Good rhythm, though.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#20/text: Heh, a goblin eyed my axe. Not a chance, lad.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#22/text: Played hide-and-seek with the {monster}. I won~
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#23/text: Danced to the goblin drums. Kidding~
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#24/text: I smell like leather now. Don't tell anyone!
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#25/text: Tiptoed along the mossy trail~ Light as a feather!
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#30/text: Swiped a goblin's cooking pot. Heh heh.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#31/text: The forest was singing. It felt wonderful.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#32/text: I passed the {monster} quietly through the treetops.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#33/text: The forest always smells like home to me.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#34/text: The goblins were loud, but rather cute.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#35/text: I guided a lost fawn back to its mother.
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#0/text: The goblins hid when they saw me! Word must be out!
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#1/text: The {monster}? Not scared one bit anymore!
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#2/text: Forest stroll done! Manastone just lying on the path!
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#3/text: A Giant Spider saw my sword and zipped up its web! Haha!
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#4/text: The {monster} blocked the path, so I politely asked it to scoot~
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#5/text: Goblin Woods is basically my backyard now!
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#6/text: Scooped up Leather and Manastone! Big sales today, Boss?
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#7/text: It was so comfy out there I almost feel guilty~
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#9/text: The {monster} asked for my autograph! Hehe, just kidding!
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#10/text: Brought back an armful of Manastone! How's that?
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#16/text: Heh heh, the goblin brats called me Grandpa.
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#18/text: A lap of the woods. Didn't break a sweat.
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#19/text: Heh, a Goblin Scout even gave me directions.
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#20/text: Manastone just lying around. Brought it home.
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#21/text: The goblins started a Sera fan club, I hear~
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#22/text: The {monster}? One wink and it's over!
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#23/text: The forest's my playground. Tree climbing's the best!
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#25/text: Finished so fast I had time to braid my hair!
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#26/text: Goblins had stew on the boil. Got myself a spoonful.
